pretrained.normalization_transfer: model.norm.{weight,bias} -> model.fc_norm.{weight,bias}; same pretrained tensors, official global-average pooling variant

external_pretraining_overlap: Unknown. Teacher/pretraining images are not exhaustively available for an image-level overlap audit. This is an exploratory pretrained-model comparison; no uncontaminated-external-pretraining claim.
supervision: All supplied fitting labels/records retained. Original duplicate/class weighting applied once. No oversampling.
augmentation: Fit only: horizontal reflection, moderate gain/contrast/gamma and multiplicative speckle. No vertical reflection or artificial test copies.
preprocessing: RGB 224px bilinear letterbox and official ImageNet mean/std normalization
scope: Exploratory after historical test review. Different architecture/pretraining than the old CNN; gains cannot be attributed to pretraining alone.
